answers.core:
I have explored an addon solution, but ran into two major problems:

- The lack of extensibility of property exports (you can't modify how export works or C#'s source generator)
- Difficulty of validating interface types (you cannot detect which class implements which interface unless it's a tool)

What I ended up with is a [hacky solution using reflection](https://github.com/poohcom1/GodotInterfaceExport) that is quite slow, and still requires boilerplate code.
answers.workaround:
There are two workarounds:

1. Use base abstract classes. This offers the type safety during node/resource selection and is fully integrated. However, it does not allow for different base classes to implement the same abstract class.
2. Export a Node/Resource type and cast it:

    ```cs
    [Export]
    public Node ComponentNode;
    private IComponentA _componentNode => ComponentNode as IComponentA;
    ```

    This doesn't give us editor-side type safety or filtering convenience, and results in boilerplate.

title: Add support for exporting C# interface types as Nodes or Resources
